result:
Fixed! The bug was in the discount logic at line 42 of `tally/invoice.py`.

**The Issue:** The condition checked `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS` but should be `>=`. The test name "test_bulk_discount_starts_at_ten_units" indicates the discount should apply AT exactly 10 units, not only after 10. 

**The Fix:** Changed the comparison operator from `>` to `>=`, so the 5% bulk discount now applies when the order has 10 or more units, instead of requiring more than 10 units.

This fixes the failing test case where an invoice with exactly 10 units should receive an 80-cent discount (5% of 1600 cents subtotal).
